name: circumvention-distributor
description: Anonymous, accountable credential distribution (Plane 1) + measurement collection (Plane 3)

scripts.keygen:manifest: node -e "const{generateKeyPairSync}=require('crypto');const{publicKey,privateKey}=generateKeyPairSync('ed25519');console.log('MANIFEST_SK (secret, base64 pkcs8):');console.log(privateKey.export({type:'pkcs8',format:'der'}).toString('base64'));console.log('\nOPERATOR_PUBKEY (pin into probe agents, base64 raw):');console.log(publicKey.export({type:'spki',format:'der'}).subarray(12).toString('base64'));"
